fixes: F2 (plus 1.5, the last language points; the gate does not depend on it). Run the sweep mechanically and review the full output rather than working from prescribed items: grep -o for lowercase-hyphen-lowercase tokens across the report, then solidify every two-element Hungarian compound, leaving (i) three-element compounds over six syllables (munkaerő-kínálat, államkötvény-arbitrázs, bázisráta-pánikféke), (ii) any compound with a foreign or proper-noun element (FedWatch-transzmisszió, chokepoint-aritmetika, Schelling-pont, Bollinger-középvonal, payroll-print, stablecoin-, backtest-, carry-, perp-).
